channel.title: PlainBTC
channel.description: Plain-English Bitcoin & crypto news for beginners

item.title: Chainflip says hacker also took 122.86 bitcoin, lifting the loss to about $12 million; it offers a 10% bounty
item.description: Chainflip now lists 122.86 BTC among the coins taken on Nov. 21, on top of the ETH and stablecoins, about $12 million in total. It offers the attacker 10% to return 90% by 12:38 p.m. Central time on Monday.

item.title: Bitcoin Core fixes an AI-found bug that could stall nodes; about 40% of public nodes still run affected versions
item.description: Bitcoin Core disclosed CVE-2026-117348, a bug found by an AI scan that let a peer stall a node for over a dozen seconds per message. Fixes are in 30.5, 31.3 and 32.1; about 8,800 public nodes still report affected versions.

item.title: Bitcoin sold for C$24,250 on Kraken's Canadian-dollar market; Kraken says the trades stand
item.description: Early Saturday, bitcoin sold for as little as C$24,250 on Kraken's Canadian-dollar market while its dollar price stayed above $57,000. Kraken says it found no breach and the trades stand.

item.title: Crypto swap service Chainflip drained of about $4.86 million; FLIP token tumbles
item.description: One validly signed transaction at 1:10 a.m. Central time moved 520.22 ETH, 3.25 million USDC and 758,141 USDT out of Chainflip's Ethereum vault. Chainflip paused swaps, and FLIP fell about 40% at the worst point.

item.title: Bitcoin crashes to $55,100, its lowest since 2024, then jumps back above $60,000
item.description: Bitcoin hit $55,100 on Kraken at 12:17 a.m. Central time on Saturday, its lowest since September 2024, as about $2.4 billion in leveraged bets were liquidated. By 8:03 a.m. it had bounced to $60,883, up 10.5% from the low.

item.title: Bitcoin briefly sets a new 2026 low near $57,660 as Strategy shares sink nearly 10%
item.description: Bitcoin hit $57,661 on Kraken at 1:26 p.m. Central time on Friday, a new low for 2026 by less than $100, before bouncing to about $58,800. Strategy shares fell 9.7% to $77.80 and the Nasdaq dropped 5.3%.

item.title: Bitcoin falls below $59,000 and nears its 2026 low as $1.5 billion in bets are wiped out
item.description: Bitcoin fell to about $58,005 on Kraken around midday Friday, its lowest price since early July and less than 0.5% above the 2026 low of $57,740, as the Nasdaq slid nearly 4% and about $1.5 billion in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated.

item.title: Senate passes DEATH BETS Act to ban prediction market bets on war and death
item.description: The Senate passed S. 4035, the DEATH BETS Act from Sens. Adam Schiff and John Curtis, by voice vote on Nov. 19. It would ban CFTC-registered exchanges from listing event contracts tied to war, terrorism, assassination, U.S. military operations or an individual's death. It now goes to the House.

item.title: BlackRock's bitcoin ETF has its biggest one-day outflow ever: $541.1 million
item.description: BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) lost a net $541.1 million on Thursday, Nov. 19, beating its previous one-day record of $528.3 million from January. All U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost $582.3 million that day and about $3.47 billion so far in November.

item.title: SEC says fake advisers and fake crypto apps took $37 million from 1,500 Americans
item.description: On Nov. 19 the SEC sued eight Colorado-based companies, likely run from overseas, over a scheme it says took about $37.4 million from more than 1,500 U.S. investors through fake investment advisers, WhatsApp chats and fake crypto trading platforms.

item.title: Bitcoin drops below $62,000 to its lowest price since July as stocks slide
item.description: Bitcoin slid to about $61,353 on Kraken on Thursday afternoon, below last weekend's low and its weakest price since July 6, as the Nasdaq and the Dow each fell about 2%. U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs have seen net withdrawals of about $2.89 billion in November.

item.title: Coinbase launches crypto options for users outside the U.S., with U.S. access promised "soon"
item.description: Coinbase launched crypto options for eligible customers in select countries outside the U.S. on Thursday, Nov. 19, using Deribit's liquidity. The contracts cover six assets and settle in USDC. CEO Brian Armstrong said U.S. users will get options "soon" through Coinbase Pro.

item.title: U.S. launches a Threat Disruption Center to fight crypto scams, with TRM Labs running its tech
item.description: The Homeland Security Task Force, co-led by DHS and the Justice Department, launched a Threat Disruption Center on Nov. 18 to trace scam money, warn victims sooner and freeze stolen crypto. Blockchain analytics firm TRM Labs is its main private partner.

item.title: Report: $518 million tied to hackers, including North Korea, flowed through Sky's stablecoin swap
item.description: Crypto risk firm Inca Digital traced $518 million in transactions by wallets tied to hackers and other illicit actors through Sky's stablecoin swap module, including $101.9 million linked to North Korea. It warns that the $2.7 billion USDC reserve could be frozen in one go.

item.title: Ledger confirms tampered hardware wallets in Berlin and is checking two more in Dubai
item.description: Ledger says tampered hardware wallets designed to capture recovery phrases have been confirmed in Berlin, and it is investigating two suspected units bought in Dubai. The company calls it the same incident it first disclosed in October.

item.title: Six senators ask Treasury to protect state-licensed stablecoin issuers before GENIUS Act rules start
item.description: Six senators from both parties asked Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to give state-licensed stablecoin issuers the same temporary safe harbor that federally supervised issuers get under a draft GENIUS Act rule, before the law takes effect on Jan. 18, 2027.

item.title: Fed minutes point to more rate hikes as bitcoin slips below $63,000
item.description: Minutes of the Fed's Oct. 27-28 meeting, released Wednesday, show almost all officials expect further rate hikes. Bitcoin fell below $63,000 earlier in the day after Governor Christopher Waller called for a half-point increase in December.

item.title: Binance says it has an Abu Dhabi court order to recover frozen hack funds as stolen ether moves again
item.description: Binance says it secured a court order from Abu Dhabi Global Market to help recover crypto frozen after the record $6.3 billion hack. About $2.85 billion was frozen or intercepted, while hack-linked wallets moved 74,880 ether on Tuesday.

item.title: Russia lets ordinary investors buy bitcoin, ether and USDT, capped at 300,000 rubles a year
item.description: A Bank of Russia rule that took effect Nov. 17 lets ordinary investors buy bitcoin, ether and USDT through licensed intermediaries, up to 300,000 rubles a year per intermediary after a knowledge test. Big brokers T-Bank and VTB are still testing.

item.title: Judge acquits MIT brothers in $25 million Ethereum trading-bot case, ending the first U.S. criminal MEV prosecution
item.description: A federal judge acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno over a 2023 trade that took about $25 million from Ethereum trading bots in 12 seconds, ruling prosecutors failed to prove a material lie. It ends the first U.S. criminal case over an MEV exploit.

item.title: CFTC approves Backpack's blockchain-based derivatives exchange, opening a U.S. path for crypto perpetual futures
item.description: The CFTC approved Backpack's U.S. derivatives exchange and clearinghouse, which use blockchain to execute and settle trades, after similar approvals for tZERO. Backpack plans 24/7 leveraged crypto perpetual futures for U.S. users. No launch date yet.

item.title: Goldman Sachs and Wells Fargo more than doubled their bitcoin ETF holdings before the selloff, filings show
item.description: Quarterly 13F filings show Goldman Sachs held $1.283 billion in spot bitcoin ETFs and Wells Fargo $2.35 billion in BlackRock's IBIT on Sept. 30, more than double June. The numbers predate bitcoin's slide and a $1.91 billion outflow streak.

item.title: Coinbase opens crypto-backed loans to New York, completing its rollout to all 50 states
item.description: Coinbase has opened its crypto-backed loans to New York after state approval, so customers in all 50 states can now borrow USDC against bitcoin. New Yorkers get a smaller menu: BTC, ETH and SOL as collateral and variable rates only.

item.title: Trezor says a shipping partner breach exposed data from about 27,000 hardware wallet orders
item.description: Trezor says hackers broke into its shipping partner Skladon and likely exported names, addresses, phone numbers and order details for about 27,000 hardware wallet orders. Wallet backups and PINs were not involved, but some customers already report scam calls.

item.title: Hackers used Optimizely to plant crypto-stealing code on 178 big websites, including Ledger
item.description: An attacker abused a flaw in Optimizely's web-testing tool to plant code on 178 organizations' websites, including Ledger and HSBC. It swapped crypto wallet addresses for the attacker's. About $7,000 was taken before the code was removed.

item.title: Solana Foundation says it now holds a majority stake in CoinGecko, the crypto price site
item.description: The Solana Foundation says it now holds a majority interest in CoinGecko, the price-tracking site with 18 million registered users. No price was disclosed, and CoinGecko says its site and data keep working as usual.

item.title: Supreme Court won't hear Custodia's case, leaving the Fed free to deny crypto banks a master account
item.description: The Supreme Court declined to hear Custodia Bank's appeal on Monday, ending the Wyoming crypto bank's fight for a Fed master account and confirming the Fed's discretion to refuse one.

item.title: Solana drops its "mainnet beta" label after six years and calls the network Solana 1.0
item.description: The Solana Foundation retired the "mainnet beta" label on Monday and introduced Solana 1.0. SOL balances and apps stay the same, and users do not need to take any action.

item.title: Lighter pauses withdrawals after a leaked trading key lets an attacker take $10.4 million
item.description: An attacker used one trader's leaked API key to move about $10.4 million in USDC out of the Lighter exchange on Monday. Lighter paused withdrawals, recovered about $5 million and reopened the same day.

item.title: Strategy buys 485 more bitcoin in a down week, lifting its stack to 850,849 BTC
item.description: Strategy bought 485 bitcoin for $33.4 million from Nov. 9 to 15 and now holds 850,849 BTC at an average cost of $75,452, well above Monday's price near $64,000. Most of the cash it raised went to buying back preferred stock. Strive added 251 BTC.

item.title: Crypto Fear & Greed Index sinks to 10, its most fearful reading since June
item.description: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 10 out of 100 on Sunday and Monday, down from 29 a week earlier and its lowest level since June, as bitcoin traded near $64,000 after a four-month low. Past extreme readings were followed by both rebounds and new lows.

item.title: Luxor says hackers hijacked bitcoin miners through its Commander software
item.description: Attackers used Luxor's Commander fleet software to point bitcoin mining machines at the OCEAN pool on Saturday night, with reports putting the redirected power near 13 EH/s. Luxor says it patched the flaw within two hours and will pay affected clients in full.

item.title: Germany votes to let customs seize crypto over €100,000 when its origin is unclear
item.description: Germany's Bundestag passed a customs reform that would let officers hold crypto and other assets worth over €100,000 of doubtful origin for up to 180 days, even without a criminal case. A court must approve any final confiscation, and the states still need to consent.

item.title: Korean exchange Coinone says a hacker took support data that may include passwords
item.description: An attacker broke into the servers of Coinone's outsourced customer support firm and may have taken passwords, ID numbers and wallet addresses that users shared in support chats. Coinone says trading and wallets were not hit.

item.title: Yield token stUSDT is shutting down: holders have until May 14, 2027 to redeem for USDT
item.description: The stUSDT protocol stopped paying rewards on Nov. 14 and gave holders until May 14, 2027 to redeem for USDT. Its value locked, about $2.3 billion at the 2023 peak, is now near $8.4 million.

item.title: Bitcoin sinks to about $62,000, a four-month low, as $2 billion in crypto bets are wiped out
item.description: Bitcoin fell to about $61,970 late Saturday, its lowest price since mid-July, as nearly $2 billion of leveraged crypto bets were forcibly closed, then bounced back above $65,000.

item.title: Bitcoin falls below $64,000 to a three-month low as fear hits extreme levels
item.description: Bitcoin hit about $63,243 on Saturday, its lowest price since mid-August, as the crypto Fear and Greed Index dropped to 10.

item.title: Kava Lend hacked for about $3.8 million as KAVA token falls nearly 40%
item.description: An attacker drained about $3.8 million of KAVA from the Kava Lend protocol through a flaw in an unused BUSD market, and the token fell nearly 40%.

item.title: Ether, solana and XRP fall harder than bitcoin as BTC touches $65,000
item.description: Solana fell nearly 10% in a day, ether hit its lowest price since July and XRP slipped below $1 as bitcoin briefly touched $65,000.

item.title: Binance reopens withdrawals on 87 networks and aims to finish next week
item.description: Binance says it reopened withdrawals on 87 networks this week and aims to restore all remaining networks and assets by the end of next week.

item.title: Bitcoin slips below $67,000 as ETF investors pull $1.07 billion in a week
item.description: Bitcoin hit its lowest price since Aug. 19 as spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $1.07 billion this week and fear gauges sank deeper into "extreme fear."

item.title: Indian exchange Unocoin says hackers used its old paper backup keys to take about $200,000 in crypto
item.description: Unocoin says hackers used its own backup keys to drain three hot wallets of about $200,000, getting around a freeze at custody firm BitGo. Customer data may also be exposed.

item.title: Falling prices squeeze crypto treasury firms: Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million, BTCS sells ether to protect a loan
item.description: Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million against its bitcoin and pushed repayment into 2027, while BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep a $64 million Aave loan safe.

item.title: Kraken parent Payward's earnings drop two-thirds from a year ago as crypto trading cools
item.description: Kraken's parent Payward said Q3 adjusted EBITDA fell to $60 million from $178.6 million a year earlier as trading slowed, while funded accounts rose 37% to 7.1 million.

item.title: DOJ, Wall Street and DeFi firms back lawsuit against Illinois' 0.2% crypto tax
item.description: The DOJ, Wall Street's biggest lobby and top DeFi firms back a lawsuit against Illinois' 0.2% tax on crypto trades, transfers and storage. The tax is paused until July 2027.

item.title: DTCC plans to bring tokenized stocks, ETFs and Treasuries to Solana in 2027
item.description: Wall Street's settlement giant DTCC will connect its tokenization service to Solana in the second half of 2027, bringing tokenized stocks, ETFs and Treasuries to the network.

item.title: Bitcoin falls below $70,000 and its 200-week average as traders bet on a Fed rate hike
item.description: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 for the first time since August and dipped under its 200-week average as traders priced in a December Fed rate hike.

item.title: Trump names four SEC and CFTC nominees, including a replacement for crypto advocate Hester Peirce
item.description: Trump nominated two people each to the SEC and CFTC, including Steven Levine to replace crypto advocate Hester Peirce. All four need Senate approval.

item.title: U.S. gets court approval to seize $1.2 billion stolen in the Binance hack and disrupts a North Korean fake video call scheme
item.description: The Justice Department can now seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion stolen in the Binance hack, and the FBI disrupted North Korea's FaceStealer fake video call scheme.

item.title: MSCI will drop Strategy from its indexes as bitcoin slides to its lowest price since August
item.description: MSCI confirmed it will remove Strategy, the largest corporate bitcoin holder, from its global indexes after Nov. 30, as bitcoin slid to its lowest price since August.

item.title: SEC backs the CFTC on stock perpetuals and clears options on more crypto ETFs
item.description: The SEC sided with the CFTC in a court fight over stock perpetual futures and cleared Nasdaq ISE to list options on crypto ETFs that hold assets beyond bitcoin and ether.

item.title: Stablecoin supply shrinks at the fastest pace since 2022 as Tether's USDT loses $6.6 billion
item.description: Stablecoin supply is shrinking at its fastest pace since 2022, with Tether's USDT down $6.6 billion in 60 days. Analysts say that leaves less buying power for bitcoin.

item.title: Hackers hijack crypto bridge Across's website through its domain registrar; about $350,000 drained
item.description: Hackers hijacked crypto bridge Across's website through its domain registrar and drained an estimated $350,000. Across says affected users will be made whole.

item.title: OKX and NYSE owner ICE set Nov. 23 launch for 24/7 tokenized stock trading in the U.S.
item.description: OKX and NYSE owner ICE will open 24/7 trading of tokenized U.S. stocks on Nov. 23, with Coinbase, Circle, Strategy and 59 Direxion ETFs among 70+ assets.

item.title: Bitcoin drops below $73,000 for the first time since August as bond yields jump
item.description: Bitcoin slid to about $72,585 on Tuesday, its lowest since Aug. 20, as Treasury yields jumped and $716 million in crypto bets were liquidated.

item.title: Binance warns iPhone users that an iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet seed phrases
item.description: Binance says a public iOS bug, worse_query, could let malicious apps read wallet seed phrases. No thefts are reported; delete untrusted apps and update.

item.title: Binance blocks MEXC transfers after a U.S. Treasury order over $16.7 billion in alleged illicit flows
item.description: Binance will decline transfers to MEXC and hold deposits from it for review, after a FinCEN order that cuts MEXC off from U.S. firms on Dec. 10.

item.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi and other banks reportedly commit $270 million to a joint dollar stablecoin
item.description: Big banks reportedly committed about $270 million to Project Faro, a joint dollar stablecoin aimed at the first half of 2027 that would compete with Tether and Circle.

item.title: Bitcoin slips toward $73,400 after a hotter-than-expected October inflation report
item.description: October CPI rose 0.4%, above forecasts. Bitcoin dipped to about $73,400 as traders bet on a December Fed hike and ETF outflows continued.

item.title: North Korea is minting meme coins to launder the $6.4 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says
item.description: Elliptic traced stolen Binance funds through six home-made meme tokens on NEAR, while about $2.85 billion of the loot stays frozen.

item.title: Gemini referral bonus: how it works (2026)
item.description: A plain-English reading of Gemini’s official Recruit referral terms as of 2026: the $50-each offer in listed markets, the 30-day qualifying trade, payout timing, and the markets Gemini closed in April 2026.

item.title: River referral bonus: how it works (2026)
item.description: An educational walkthrough of River’s published referral rewards (up to $100 in bitcoin each, in tiers after $100, $1,000, and $10,000 of qualifying bitcoin buys) and the 180-day rules on River’s help center.

item.title: What is a crypto wallet? Custodial vs. self-custody, explained for beginners
item.description: A wallet doesn’t hold coins, it holds keys. Learn the difference between custodial and self-custody wallets, what a recovery phrase is, and how to start safely.

item.title: How much Bitcoin should a beginner buy? A plain-English guide to dollar-cost averaging
item.description: No one can tell you the right amount, but you can pick a sensible way to decide. We explain dollar-cost averaging, test it on real price data, and show how to set up a recurring buy.

item.title: Is Coinbase safe for beginners? What’s protected, what isn’t, and how to lower your risk
item.description: A plain-English safety check of Coinbase: how it stores crypto, what is and isn’t insured, what the 2025 data breach was, and a checklist to protect your account.

item.title: Coinbase wins a full national trust charter from the OCC: what it means
item.description: The OCC approved Coinbase National Trust Company on Nov. 6, putting its institutional crypto custody under federal bank supervision. Here’s what the charter allows.

item.title: FinCEN and the Fed scrap the $250 Travel Rule plan, $3,000 threshold stays
item.description: U.S. regulators withdrew a 2020 proposal to cut cross-border thresholds to $250 and drop crypto-specific wording. Here’s what changed, and what did not.

item.title: Bitcoin loses its 50-week moving average as long liquidations top $1 billion
item.description: BTC closed below ~$75,488 after seven weeks above the line, while CoinGlass logged $1.15B in liquidations. What Galaxy’s checkpoint means next.

item.title: PNC Bank pilots USDC payments with Coinbase for corporate clients
item.description: Eligible corporates can receive USDC on Ethereum via Coinbase Payments, with automatic 1:1 conversion into a PNC dollar deposit.

item.title: Bitcoin’s weekend whipsaw: $1B liquidated as Nvidia headlines hit risk assets
item.description: BTC briefly slipped to ~$73,761 before reclaiming $75,000. Here’s what drove the move, who got liquidated, and what traders are watching next.

item.title: How to buy your first Bitcoin on Coinbase (U.S. beginner guide)
item.description: A step-by-step walkthrough: create an account, verify your identity, add a payment method, place a small first buy, and keep fees and security in mind.

item.title: After the midterms: ETF outflows and a tougher crypto rulebook ahead?
item.description: Spot bitcoin ETFs just posted their largest weekly outflow since June. Markets are pricing regulatory uncertainty as Democrats prepare to lead Congress.

item.title: Bitcoin ETF vs buying bitcoin: which makes sense for a U.S. beginner?
item.description: Spot bitcoin ETFs give price exposure inside a brokerage account. Buying bitcoin gives you the asset itself. Here is how U.S. beginners can compare custody, fees, IRAs, and taxes.

item.title: Coinbase fees explained: spread, Advanced maker/taker, and what a beginner actually pays
item.description: A plain-English breakdown of Coinbase fees: the variable spread on simple buys and sells, Advanced maker/taker tiers, Coinbase One, and how to compare costs on the preview screen.

item.title: How to cash out bitcoin on Coinbase to your bank (U.S. steps, timing, and taxes)
item.description: Step-by-step for U.S. users: sell bitcoin to your Coinbase cash balance, withdraw to a linked bank via ACH or instant cashout, and note the tax reporting basics.
